lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gills along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like appearance on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature extending along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 12 small, medium-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the lower half.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly dense, fine-grained distribution of micro-spots is visible across the anterior dorsal head region, contrasting with the larger, more spaced blobs on the mid-body.
